description: Swimming pool border tile from Pak Clay, made for the edge and waterline band of a pool, where a decorative strip frames the main tiling. A border tile can set the colour theme of a pool and neaten the line where water meets the surround. Pool tiles are generally chosen for water resistance, so ask about the right adhesive and grout for wet use. Colours look different on screen, so view a sample before ordering. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your pool size and city for a dated written quote.
